author: National Geographic
description:
As part of The Walt Disney Company and National Geographic's “Step into Wonder” Earth Month campaign, National Geographic launches the third annual Earth Month Sweepstakes, giving fans the opportunity to win a once-in-a-lifetime prize trip with National Geographic-Lindblad Expeditions to experience either Alaska’s glaciers or Galápagos’ wildlife.

Enter daily at https://www.natgeo.com/earthmonthsweeps for your chance to win the trip of a lifetime from April 13-30, 2026.*

*NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. Enter Sweepstakes between 4/13/26 at 6:00 AM ET and 4/30/26 at 11:59 PM ET. Open to legal residents of the 50 U.S. & D.C., who are 18+ at time of entry. Visit https://www.natgeo.com/earthmonthsweeps for Official Rules including details on how to enter, eligibility requirements, odds of winning, prize description and limitations. Void where prohibited.  Sponsor: National Geographic Partners, LLC, 1145 17th Street NW, Washington, D.C. 20036.
